items.heading: Goulash
details: Key ingredients: beef, paprika, onion, potato, caraway
Brown beef chunks with plenty of onion.
Stir in a generous amount of sweet paprika and caraway.
Add potato and enough water or stock to simmer.
Cook slowly until the beef is tender and the stew is thick and richly red.

items.heading: Chicken Paprikash
details: Key ingredients: chicken, paprika, onion, sour cream
Brown chicken pieces with onion until golden.
Stir in a generous amount of paprika and a little stock.
Simmer until the chicken is fully cooked and tender.
Finish the sauce with sour cream and serve over dumplings or noodles.

items.heading: Fisherman's Soup
details: Ingredients: vegetables, protein or legumes, onion, garlic, stock, herbs/spices and salt.
Sauté aromatics, add the remaining ingredients and stock, simmer gently until tender, then adjust seasoning.
